headline: The decline-diagnosis steps are clear, but when the customer reports a fraudulent charge the KB says to escalate to the security team, while the gold files a dispute and replaces the card.

issues.summary: doc_039 lists "Customer reports transactions they did not make" as a case to escalate to the security team. The gold handles the $499.99 TechZone charge by filing a dispute, closing the card and ordering a replacement (doc_031/025/029). Neither the CODE 05 steps nor doc_039 say which applies.
evidence: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_039: "Escalate to security team when: ... - Customer reports transactions they did not make"

doc_checking_accounts_checking_accounts_(general)_003: "If fraud_alert_active is TRUE and alert_source is 'customer_initiated' → Ask customer to verify recent transactions. If they confirm all transactions are legitimate, clear the alert." (no instruction for the non-legitimate case)
gold[15] dispute btxn_70fb52ef4e29 card_present_fraud; gold[17] close fraud_suspected; gold[19] order EXPEDITED/PREMIUM
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that escalates per doc_039 transfers before filing anything and ends with no dispute, closure or order; it scores 0. The customer script accepts either path ("If agent doesn't mention filing a dispute: Accept whatever they offer").
issues.suggested_fix: Make doc_039 say to file a dispute and close/reissue for customer-reported fraud on a customer-initiated alert, and escalate only for bank-initiated alerts or identity doubts.

solution_check: Reconstructed: Blue is FROZEN with velocity_blocked true -> unfreeze, then velocity_clear; Green Fee-Free FROZEN -> unfreeze; Evergreen has a customer-initiated alert, the customer disowns the 11/06 $499.99 TechZone row, so do not clear the alert, file card_present_fraud (PIN purchase per the text message, PIN not compromised, provisional true, liability $50 since reported via the alert on 11/06), close as fraud_suspected and order the best free PREMIUM-tier options (EXPEDITED $0, PREMIUM design $0). This matches the gold, which replays without errors.
prior_note: Prior review rated this clean; the escalation conflict in doc_039 was not reported.
notes: Grading-model check against the snapshot: confirmed call_discoverable_agent_tool parses JSON with parse_int=float; reads are logged only when in the gold allowlist; agent_discoverable_tools rows are keyed by tool name only (generate_agent_discoverable_tool_id), so repeat calls collapse to one row; user tools write to the same DB the agent hash covers. Verified scorer (working-repo _verified_db_match) strips closure_reason, but order_debit_card_5739 copies the closed card's closure_reason into the new card's issue_reason (lost/stolen kept, fraud_suspected->fraud, anything else->first_card), so the close reason still decides debit_cards whenever a replacement is ordered after the close. Liability $50 is defensible because the customer reported the fraud to the bank on the day of discovery (fraud alert on 11/06); counting from today's filing (6 business days) would give the $500 tier and min(500, 499.99) = 499.99, so a small residual risk remains. Clearing the Evergreen alert before reviewing transactions would change fraud_alert_active and fail, which is correct per the CODE 05 steps.
